entity.name: Southeast Asian Language and Regional Studies

facts.value: The module typically consists of two language courses and a seminar where participants from different language courses come together to discuss regional similarities and differences within ASEAN. The languages available generally are Thai, Vietnamese, and Dutch (for source studies), provided the respective language has not yet been taken in the Bachelor's program. Depending on availability, other languages, advanced courses in Thai or Vietnamese, or a language-independent module on regional expertise can also be taken.

entity.name: Southeast Asian Language and Regional Studies

facts.value: Basic knowledge of another Southeast Asian language as a basis for flexible job opportunities in different countries of the region; reading skills in Dutch as a foundation for working with historical sources related to Indonesia; depending on offerings, advanced language courses for deepening a language begun in the Bachelor's program (e.g., Thai); reflection on the regional diversity and its relationship to political initiatives of regional integration in ASEAN.
